title: Introduce strict CATEGORY_LABELS mapping for taxonomy slugs and use it everywhere in UI

requirements.text: Create a strict, centralized category display-label mapping system in the frontend by introducing a `CATEGORY_LABELS` dictionary that maps category slugs to human-readable labels, and a single helper function that UI code must call to render category labels. The dictionary must include (at minimum) the exact mappings provided by the user: construction→Construction, agriculture→Agriculture, homeservices→Home Services, transport→Transport, homeimprovement→Home Improvement, specializedcleaning→Specialized Cleaning, generalservices→General Services, woodmetal→Wood & Metal Works, treework→Tree Cutting & Coconut Climbing, householdservices→Household Services, vehicleservices→Vehicle Services, tailoring→Tailoring, aariwork→Aari Work, catering→Cooking / Catering, eventservices→Event Services, printing→Printing & Flex, repair→Repair Services, electrical→Electrical, plumbing→Plumbing, painting→Painting, carpenter→Carpentry, welding→Welding. The helper must normalize incoming slugs (case/whitespace/punctuation tolerant) for lookup.

quotes:
Create a CATEGORY_LABELS dictionary and always use it in UI.

Example mapping:

construction: Construction
...
welding: Welding

acceptanceCriteria: A `CATEGORY_LABELS` constant exists in the frontend codebase and contains the exact user-provided slug→label mappings.
There is exactly one shared helper used to convert a raw category slug into a display label, and it normalizes input before dictionary lookup (e.g., casing differences do not break mapping).
The helper returns a human-readable string for every input category slug, never the raw slug.

requirements.text: Enforce the rendering rules for category slugs across the UI: (1) the UI must never render the raw category slug string; (2) if the slug is not found in `CATEGORY_LABELS`, render a safe fallback that is capitalized words (human-readable), not the original raw slug; (3) database values and navigation/search params must remain unchanged (mapping is display-only).

quotes:
Rules:
1) UI must NEVER show raw slug
2) If slug not found → show capitalized words (fallback)

Database values must remain unchanged.
Only UI display text uses CATEGORY_LABELS.

acceptanceCriteria: If a category slug is not in `CATEGORY_LABELS`, the displayed label is a capitalized-words fallback (e.g., derived from slug formatting), and the raw slug is never shown.
No changes are made to stored backend values or the values used in URL params/search filters; only the displayed text changes.
There are no user-visible instances of raw slugs like "homeimprovement" or "specializedcleaning" in the app UI.

requirements.text: Apply the strict category label mapping helper everywhere category slugs can become user-visible, specifically covering: Home page category cards, Search Results page titles and any category labels, Worker Profile page work/category badges, Live suggestions dropdown display text, and category/filter UI (including any chips/buttons/headings that show category values). Replace any current usage that relies on auto-guessing (e.g., heuristics/title-casing directly on raw values) for category slugs with the centralized mapping helper.

quotes:
Apply mapping everywhere:
   - category cards
   - search results
   - worker profile
   - suggestions
   - filters

acceptanceCriteria: Home page category cards render category names using the centralized `CATEGORY_LABELS` mapping helper (no direct rendering of raw `taxonomy.categories` values).
Search Results page title and grouped section headings do not display raw category slugs; any category shown uses the centralized mapping helper.
Worker Profile page work/category badge never displays a raw slug and uses the centralized mapping helper when showing category-derived text.
LiveSuggestionSearchBox suggestions render category-like values using the centralized mapping helper (display-only), while still submitting/navigating using the original suggestion value.
SearchEmptyRecovery and any filter UI elements that show category values use the centralized mapping helper so raw slugs are never visible.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Do not change database/stored taxonomy values in the backend; mapping is display-only.
User-facing text in this change request must remain English-only (do not introduce new Tamil-first copy as part of this mapping change).
nonGoals: Do not modify backend taxonomy schema, stored worker/job records, or any Motoko APIs as part of this change.
Do not change routing, URL parameter formats, or search behavior; only change displayed labels.
Do not redesign layouts or restyle components; scope is label rendering consistency only.
